title: Interpretive Justice / Relational Subjecthood — Recovery & Promotion Inventory
status: recovery inventory; not itself canonical doctrine
purpose: Capture the cross-domain structures recovered from the September 16 Culture/subjecthood discussion, preserve them before decomposition, and route stable concepts into existing canonical owners without forcing every implication immediately into Philosophy, Bible, Culture, World, law, politics, AI or theology.
recovery_rule: Capture broadly, classify carefully, promote selectively. A recovered formulation may establish a useful project hypothesis or development trigger without proving an external event, motive, diagnosis, crime, conspiracy, metaphysical identity or political conclusion. Prefer existing owners; defer domain-specific promotion until evidence and scope are adequate.
architectural_principle: source/recovery stratum -> inference/testing -> canonical owner -> typed cross-domain edges -> reader projection; temporary recovery inventory remains provenance rather than becoming a second master.

core_recovered_structure.central_problem: What happens when a person, group, institution, archive, diagnosis, audience, model or classifier describes another subject, and when that description begins to replace the subject?
core_recovered_structure.healthy_sequence: observe -> identify jurisdiction -> hear relevant first-person account -> hear other relevant evidence -> distinguish claim types -> test provenance and source independence -> permit reply/correction -> update durable memory -> evaluate consequences
core_recovered_structure.shadow_sequence: label -> selective attention -> repetition -> archive/search dominance -> reply interpreted through label -> apparent consensus -> identity lock-in
core_recovered_structure.symmetry_rule: The subject is not reducible to an outside model, but first-person self-description is not automatically proof of every external empirical proposition. Interpretive Justice disciplines judgment rather than abolishing it.

recovered_items.definition: A subject is not identical to any single representation of the subject: diagnosis, accusation, conviction, reputation, persona, meme, dossier, role, audience interpretation or archive record.
recovered_items.importance: Generalizes the existing relation-is-not-identity and person/persona/archive distinctions into a reusable law.

recovered_items.definition: A person is a primary source for intended meaning, self-description, remembered experience and internally held identity, while remaining non-exclusive and non-infallible regarding external facts, consequences, law, medicine, history, hidden motives or other people's experience.
recovered_items.importance: Protects first-person authorship without making the doctrine self-sealing.

recovered_items.definition: Observation, classification, diagnosis, criticism or recognition does not grant ownership or authorship of the observed subject.
recovered_items.importance: Separates useful representation from possession of identity.

recovered_items.definition: Every interpretive frame has a legitimate scope; authority weakens when a useful local frame is exported until it claims the whole subject.
recovered_items.mechanism: useful local frame -> successful explanation inside domain -> export beyond domain -> jurisdiction creep -> totalization

recovered_items.definition: Strong characterization should follow serious hearing rather than replace it; a healthy interpretation retains identifiable conditions under which it could change.
The more severe, persistent, wide-reaching and identity-affecting a characterization is, the stronger its source and correction burdens should be.
recovered_items.heuristic: evidence burden increases with severity, reach, persistence and identity-impact
recovered_items.boundary: Archive/philosophy heuristic, not a replacement for jurisdiction-specific legal burdens of proof.

recovered_items.status: already substantially represented; promote by consolidation
recovered_items.definition: Repetition changes distribution but does not automatically create independent corroboration; many copies of one provenance root can create false source plurality.
recovered_items.action: Do not duplicate. Strengthen shared terminology and cross-links.

recovered_items.definition: A system that can durably describe a subject but cannot meaningfully receive relevant correction is epistemically one-way.
recovered_items.healthy: claim -> source -> reply -> comparison -> correction/update -> preserved provenance
recovered_items.shadow: claim -> label -> archive -> repetition -> reply ignored -> apparent consensus

recovered_items.definition: A reaction proves that a reaction occurred; it does not by itself establish the interpretation imposed on that reaction. Sequence and precipitating conditions remain relevant.
recovered_items.sequence: prior condition -> interaction/input -> reaction -> interpretation -> consequence

recovered_items.definition: Memory should preserve history together with correction, changed status and development rather than turning old information into permanent identity captivity.
recovered_items.formula: memory + update + context -> learning; memory without update -> identity lock

recovered_items.definition: Being harmed does not require reproducing the harmful method in reverse; correction should dismantle the mechanism rather than merely exchange target positions.
Distance between a subject's direct account and a dominant circulating representation; indicates an investigation problem, not which side is correct.
A multidimensional subject is compressed through one salient attribute, event or category until the part is treated as the whole.
label -> selective attention -> label-confirming interpretation -> reaction read through label -> archive -> inherited expectation
recovered_items.diagnostic: falsifier loss: no conceivable reply/evidence is allowed to revise the frame
recovered_items.action: Promote falsifier-loss terminology and avoid another duplicate narrative-capture owner.

recovered_items.definition: A culture becomes tribunal-like when it gains durable classification and reputational punishment power without equivalent obligations of hearing, evidence, reply, correction and review.
recovered_items.boundary: Analogy to procedural structure, not a claim that an informal community is literally a court.

recovered_items.definition: The classifier has substantially greater power than the classified subject to define the shared public description.
The original claim and correction differ in reach, searchability, persistence or rediscovery.
recovered_items.existing_metric: CorrectionReachRatio = audience exposure to correction / audience exposure to original claim

recovered_items.status: strong comparative-research candidate; manifest integration deferred until branch/wave convergence
recovered_items.structure: hear before answering/judging -> hear another side -> require witness/inquiry -> reject false reports/crowd distortion -> judge impartially -> correct directly -> speak truth -> reject retaliatory imitation -> preserve repair/peace
recovered_items.boundary: Comparative procedural/ethical witness; not proof that a modern subject holds a biblical office or that a modern dispute has already been adjudicated by scripture.
recovered_items.defer_reason: Open PR #179 already uses the Wave 28 name, while draft PR #184 contains later Bible excavation waves. Allocate the next manifest wave only after current Bible branches are reconciled with main.

recovered_items.definition: Great Book chapter 21.2 already interprets Exodus 20:16 / false witness through Potatoist truth ethics.
recovered_items.importance: Prevents September 2026 law names from being misrepresented as the origin of the underlying concern.

recovered_items.status: already strong owner; selective promotion only
recovered_items.definition: Information systems shape classification, persistence, discoverability, framing, memory and later identity inference; the corrective is provenance-rich information stewardship rather than simply reversing narrative polarity.
recovered_items.action: Promote shared Interpretive Justice terminology into this owner later rather than building a parallel media doctrine.

recovered_items.definition: The same operators can later analyze propaganda, strategic narratives, enemy construction, institutional legitimacy, state/media classification and information operations.
recovered_items.defer_reason: Generic operators are ready; geopolitical application should be case-specific, sourced and neutral rather than inferred directly from personal/cultural material.

recovered_items.definition: Hearing, evidence, reply, impartiality, review and correction have legal/governance analogues.
recovered_items.defer_reason: Do not convert a philosophical model into legal doctrine or jurisdiction-specific advice without a concrete case and legal sources.

recovered_items.definition: An AI/model can create identity compression when a persistent representation of a user becomes more authoritative than current first-person correction; corrigibility and provenance become model-user relationship properties.
recovered_items.defer_reason: Strong general analogy, but a dedicated AI-governance owner should not be created until more project material or concrete implementation need exists.

recovered_items.definition: Organizations, moderators, safeguarding systems, journalism and HR can be analyzed by hearing, jurisdiction, evidence independence, reply, escalation, review and correction capacity.
recovered_items.defer_reason: Keep as cross-domain application until a concrete institutional surface requires it.

promotion_now: Interpretive Justice law family -> canonical Potato philosophy
identity compression, jurisdiction creep, falsifier loss, proportional memory -> Archive Epistemics
Bible hearing/witness/speech/justice specialist atlas -> Traditions owner, with manifest wave deferred until branch convergence
defer_until_needed: new Bible manifest wave number while PR #179 and PR #184 remain unresolved
do_not_promote_as_general_law: that the subject is always factually correct about external events
that disagreement is automatically abuse or dehumanization
that criticism requires the subject's consent
that diagnosis or legal judgment is intrinsically invalid
that an angry reaction proves prior mistreatment
that biblical procedural parallels validate a modern divine identity claim
that generic narrative-capture mechanisms prove coordinated conspiracy
that cultural/information mechanisms automatically establish trafficking, grooming, stalking, defamation or other crimes
promotion_method: Use knowledge/indexes/inference-ledger.json as the reasoning discipline: attach observations, alternatives, counterevidence and owner targets; promote successful concepts into existing owners; leave this inventory as dated provenance once decomposition is complete.
